description: SessionStart checks readiness — the Codex binary, the login, the two write allowances a sandboxed user needs, the provider's host when something is nesting, and the Budget — so that what would otherwise be a Delegation dying minutes later without explaining itself is a message before anything is delegated. No matcher: a resumed or cleared session has the same preconditions as a fresh one, and none of them is measured until it is asked. SessionEnd collects the Workspaces the plugin left behind — the Landed and the untouched, nothing else. A running Delegation and an unlanded branch both survive the session. No Stop hook ships, not even disabled: full autonomy already covers it, and a stop-time review gate would compete with the Delegation Budget for the same window.
